name: Blending
body:
Aura faint illusion; CL 3rd; Weight —; Price +1 Bonus

DESCRIPTION

Blending armor blurs and distorts when in dim lighting conditions. As long as the wearer of a suit of blending armor is in dim light, the miss chance due to concealment increases to 50% (instead of 20%). This does not grant total concealment; it just increases the miss chance.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells silent image; Cost +1 bonus
